items.title: Jackie Cain and Roy Kral interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 22, 1998
items.q: even Joe Glaser, who was our booker

ctx.x: But I mean we would never dream of singing it now, because I mean that was when we were young and you know you could get away with such cutsie pie stuff. But now I mean, I wouldn’t dream of doing it now. But that’s the way the world goes sometimes. Because he was trying to broaden our audience, and we said well okay, maybe this time we’ll try it. But we’d been told stuff a lot of times, even Joe Glaser, who was our booker

at one time early on. We had a meeting with him, he says, “I don’t know, you kids, you walk a line, you’re not cabaret and you’re not jazz, you’re kind of walking the line there. Do one or the other.” We said well this is who we are, this is what we do, this is what we like.
